Append a DEC entry to DECISIONS.md. Allocate the next unused ID from the latest revision.

## DEC-XXX — Title

- Status: Proposed / Accepted / Superseded / Rejected.

- Decision or proposal:

Do not turn an AI recommendation into an accepted product/license/permission decision without authority. Preserve the prior entry when changing course.
